name: AlwaysShowName
description: Whether the name-tag is always displayed. Equivalent to the NBT-tag CustomNameVisible. Defaults to false.
zh: 始终显示名字（等同 CustomNameVisible）

name: AttackSpeed
description: The attack speed of the mob Defaults to vanilla attack speed of the respective mobs
default: vanilla attack speed of the respective mobs

name: VisibleByDefault
description: Sets whether the mob is visible by default when the mobs spawns or when the mob gets loaded. Defaults to true.

name: Invisible
description: Sets the permanent invisibility effect on the mob; no need to apply invisibility potion with ~onSpawn trigger. Defaults to false.

name: Collidable
description: Whether the mob has collisions. Collisions in Minecraft are bidirectional, so this would need to be set to false on both the entity colliders to ensure that no collisions takes place but will also stop the player from pushing the mob. Defaults to true.

name: DigOutOfGround
description: Teleports the mob two blocks up if it takes SUFFOCATION damage. Defaults to false.

name: Despawn
description: Determines how the mob will despawn. This option should be turned on if you're using a lot of mob spawners or entities will overwhelm your server, or the entity you are making requires some special behavior regarding its despawn policy (Npcs, Bosses etc.) Defaults to true.

name: FollowRange
description: The range in blocks within which a mob will target to attack or track an entity. Defaults to vanilla follow range - 32.

name: Glowing
description: Sets whether the mob is permanently glowing. Defaults to false.

name: HealOnReload
description: Allows non-despawning mobs to heal once the chunk they are in gets reloaded. Defaults to false.

name: Hidden
description: If true the mob will be left out of command suggestions and the mob browser menu, useful for template mobs and internal utility mobs. Defaults to false.
zh: 隐藏（不参与实体计数等）

name: Invincible
description: Makes the mob completely invincible to all types of damage. This option cannot be changed by command skills. Defaults to false.

name: Interactable
description: Sets whether the mob can be interacted with. If the mob is an armor stand, it will deny any interaction with the equipments. Defaults to false.

name: LockPitch
description: Keeps the mob's head from looking up/down. Defaults to false.

name: KnockbackResistance
description: A percentage of knockback resisted from attacks. This option can be anywhere between 0 and 1. But a mob with 100% knockback resistance can still be knocked back by a bow's enchantment: ARROW_KNOCKBACK (punch enchantment). For true knockback resistance, see the velocity mechanic page. Defaults to 0.

name: MaxCombatDistance
description: Prevents players that are a number of blocks away from damaging the mob. Setting this option to a number less than the distance of a certain mob skill or attack will ensure that the mob can damage the player and will not be as easy to exploit. Defaults to 256.

name: MovementSpeed
description: The movement speed of the mob. Most mobs has a default move speed of 0.2 and any value higher than 1 tends to make a mob difficult or impossible to fight.

name: NoAI
description: Whether the mob should have AI. This option overrides any AI goals specified in AIGoalSelectors. As opposed to AIGoalSelectors, this will work on entities that have hardcoded AI. And if this is set to true, the mob will never cast any skills. Defaults to false.

name: NoDamageTicks
description: Defines how long in ticks the mob is invulnerable after taking damage. If ImmunityTables is enabled for the mob, then NoDamageTicks will be per player instead of global. Defaults to 10.

name: NoGravity
description: Whether the mob should not have gravity. If set to true, the mob CANNOT have the velocity mechanic used on it. Defaults to false.

name: PassthroughDamage
description: Causes all damage taken to be redirected to the mob's parent, if one exists. A mob's parent is the entity that initially summoned the mob. Defaults to false.

name: PreventItemPickup
description: Prevent mobs from picking up items; Defaults to true.

name: PreventLeashing
description: Whether to prevent a leash from being placed on the mob. Defaults to true.

name: PreventMobKillDrops
description: Prevents a MythicMob's target from dropping loot. Defaults to false.

name: PreventOtherDrops
description: Prevents the mob from dropping its vanilla loot table. Defaults to false.
zh: 禁止其他插件/原版掉落

name: PreventRandomEquipment
description: Prevents the mob from spawning with random equipment. Defaults to false.

name: PreventRenaming
description: Prevents the mob from being renamed using a nametag. Defaults to true.

name: PreventSunburn
description: Prevents the mob from burning in the sun. Defaults to false.

name: PreventTransformation
description: Sets whether the mob should be prevented from being turned into other entities. Defaults to true.
zh: 防止转化（僵尸村民/溺尸等）

name: PreventVanillaDamage
description: Cancels every instance of the mob dealing "regular" vanilla damage, canceling it. Skills that triggers onAttack will still be executed. Defaults to false.

name: RepeatAllSkills
description: Whether to repeat HP based skills if a mob heals back above the health threshold. Defaults to false.

name: ReviveHealth
description: When the mob's death event gets cancelled (via a Cancelevent mechanic ~onDeath) the one specified is the amount of health the mob's will be set to. If the value is -1, the mob will heal to its own max health value.
example:
#This mob will always return to 50 health every time the death event is cancelled
ExampleMob:
 Type: COW
 Health: 100
 Options:
 ReviveHealth: 50
 Skills:
 - cancelevent{sync=true} @self ~onDeath

name: Scale
description: The scale of the mob. If set to -1, the option is ignored. Defaults to -1.

name: ShowHealth
description: Displays the health of the mob through messages broadcast within a radius and formatting by Mobs.ShowHealth.Radius and Mobs.ShowHealth.Formatting, respectively, in /plugins/MythicMobs/config.yml Defaults to false.

name: Silent
description: Whether a mob should use vanilla sound effects. Defaults to false.

name: UseThreatTable
description: Whether the mob should have Threat Tables enabled

name: RandomizeProperties
description: RandomizeProperties is the vanilla feature in charge of giving variations to mobs when they spawn, such as equipment, zombie leader status, animal variations, zombie/spider jockey, mob size, chance of spawning as baby, etc This is ideal if you are heavily overriding entity behaviors and don't want the natural randomization Defaults to true

name: Type
description: The type of the boat entity. Aliases: BoatType. Defaults to OAK

name: Age
description: The age of the mob. Use -1 for Baby and 1 for Adults. Usable on any mob that can age. For example: Sheep, Pigs, Cows... When above 0, represents the number of ticks before this mob can breed again. Equivalent to the Age NBT. Use very low negative numbers to mess with the mobs model (not supported). May not be working properly under some situations. Defaults to 1.

name: AgeLock
description: Whether the mobs age should be locked in place. Useful for keeping a baby mob from growing up over time. This is required if you want Age option to work over time. Defaults to false.

name: Adult
description: Sets adult status of mob. Use if Age does not work.

name: Baby
description: Sets baby/adult status of mob. Use if Age does not work.

name: Angry
description: Whether the mob will spawn angry or not.

name: PreventSlimeSplit
description: Prevents slimes and magmacubes from splitting. Default to false.

name: Size
description: Sets the size of slimes, magma cubes, and phantoms. Can get VERY big and get exponentially larger with each increase. Extremely high size will cause server lag and possibly crashes. Default to 1to8 (Phantoms is 1)

name: CanJoinRaid
description: Whether the entity can join a raid. Defaults to true.

name: PatrolLeader
description: Whether the entity is the leader of a patrol. Defaults to false.

name: PatrolSpawnPoint
description: Defaults to false.

name: Tameable
description: Whether players are able to tame the mob. Used for wolves, cats and horses. Defaults to false.

name: PreventJockeyMounts
description: Sets whether the zombie will be prevented from spawning as a jockey. Only works for Zombies. Defaults to false.

name: PreventConversion
description: Prevents the Zombie from being converted into other types of zombies. Defaults to false.

name: ReinforcementsChance
description: Chance for zombies to spawn reinforcements on taking damage. Should be a number between 0 and 1 (0% and 100% chance). Only works for Zombies. Defaults to 0.

name: CanMove
description: Sets whether an armor stand can move. Defaults to true and requires PaperSpigot
example:
Dummy:
 Type: ARMOR_STAND
 Options:
 CanMove: true

name: CanTick
description: Sets whether an armor stand can tick. Defaults to true and requires PaperSpigot
example:
Dummy:
 Type: ARMOR_STAND
 Options:
 CanTick: true

name: HasArms
description: Sets whether an armor stand has arms. Defaults to false.
example:
Dummy:
 Type: ARMOR_STAND
 Options:
 HasArms: true

name: HasBasePlate
description: Sets whether an armor stand has a baseplate. Defaults to true
example:
Dummy:
 Type: ARMOR_STAND
 Options:
 HasBasePlate: false

name: HasGravity
description: Sets whether the armor stand is affected by gravity. Defaults to true.
example:
Dummy:
 Type: ARMOR_STAND
 Options:
 HasGravity: true

name: ItemBody
description: Designates the Mythic Item that should go in the body/chest slot of an armor stand.
example:
Dummy:
 Type: ARMOR_STAND
 Options:
 ItemBody: AN_EXAMPLE_CHESTPLATE

name: ItemFeet
description: Designates the Mythic Item that should go in the feet slot of an armor stand.
example:
Dummy:
 Type: ARMOR_STAND
 Options:
 ItemFeet: AN_EXAMPLE_BOOTS

name: ItemHand
description: Designates the Mythic Item that should go in the main hand slot of an armor stand.
example:
Dummy:
 Type: ARMOR_STAND
 Options:
 ItemHand: AN_EXAMPLE_SWORD

name: ItemOffhand
description: Designates the Mythic Item that should go in the off hand slot of an armor stand.
example:
Dummy:
 Type: ARMOR_STAND
 Options:
 ItemOffhand: AN_EXAMPLE_STICK

name: ItemHead
description: Designates the Mythic Item that should go in the helmet slot of an armor stand.
example:
Dummy:
 Type: ARMOR_STAND
 Options:
 ItemHead: AN_EXAMPLE_HELMET

name: ItemLegs
description: Designates the Mythic Item that should go in the leggings slot of an armor stand.
example:
Dummy:
 Type: ARMOR_STAND
 Options:
 ItemLegs: AN_EXAMPLE_PANTS

name: Marker
description: Sets the armor stand as a marker. This option prevents the armor stand from being destroyed in game, making it completely non-interactable. Defaults to false.
example:
Dummy:
 Type: ARMOR_STAND
 Options:
 Marker: false
zh: 标记实体（无碰撞无体积）

name: Small
description: Sets the armor stand to small variant. Defaults to false.
example:
Dummy:
 Type: ARMOR_STAND
 Options:
 Small: true

name: Pose
description: Sets the body part's current pose. Default values are 0,0,0 and accepts ranges like #to#. These will go under the Pose section instead of the Options section.

name: Anger
description: Sets the time in ticks until bee anger ends. If set to 0 the bee will not be angry. Defaults to 0.

name: HasNectar
description: Whether the bee is carrying pollen. Defaults to false.

name: HasStung
description: Whether the bee has stung an entity. Defaults to false.

name: PreventStingerLoss
description: Whether to prevent the bee from losing its stinger once it hits an entity. Defaults to false.

name: Saddled
description: Whether the entity is saddled or not. Defaults to false.

name: Tamed
description: Whether the entity is tamed or not. Defaults to false.

name: CatType
description: Sets the type of cat. Types can be ALL_BLACK, BLACK, BRITISH_SHORTHAIR, CALICO, PERSIAN, JELLIE, RAGDOLL, RED, SIAMESE, TABBY or WHITE.

name: CollarColor
description: Sets the color of the cat's collar. Available colors are: BLACK, BLUE, BROWN, CYAN, GRAY, GREEN, LIGHT_BLUE, LIGHT_GRAY, LIME, MAGENTA, ORANGE, PINK, PURPLE, RED, WHITE, or YELLOW.

name: Variant
description: The variant to use for the cow entity. Accepts a namespace, if there is a datapack adding more variants. Read more on the subject on the Minecraft Wiki here and here

name: Jockey
description: Whether or not the chicken has the IsChickenJockey NBT set to 1. If true, the chicken can naturally despawn, drops 10 experience upon death instead of 1-3 and cannot lay eggs. Defaults to false.

name: ExplosionRadius
description: Sets the radius/power of the creepers explosion. Negative values are ignored, and the explosion radius remains the creeper's default one. Defaults to -1.

name: FuseTicks
description: Sets the number of ticks it takes for creepers to explode. Negative values are ignored, and the time it takes remains the creeper's default one. Defaults to -1.

name: SuperCharged
description: Whether the creeper should spawn as a super charged creeper. Defaults to false.

name: PreventSuicide
description: Prevents creepers from dying upon exploding. Set mobGriefing gamerule to true for this option to work. Defaults to false.

name: WeatheringState
description: The weathering state of the golem. Can be any of these values

name: Waxed
description: Whether the copper golem is waxed. Defaults to true.

name: PreventTeleport
description: Meant for Endermen but //might// work on other mobs. May break teleport skills! Defaults to false.

name: HeldBlock
description: Sets the block that the Enderman is carrying. Defaults to AIR.

name: Experience
description: Sets the amount of experience give by the experience orb mob. Defaults to 1.

name: Block
description: Determines the type of the block. Defaults to STONE.

name: BlockData
description: Additional field for inputting blockdata. Defaults to 0.

name: DropsItem
description: Should the entity be able to drops the falling block's item. Defaults to true.

name: HurtsEntities
description: Damages entities on impact. Defaults to true.

name: ReplaceSpawnLocationBlock
description: If the entity should replace the block at its spawn location. Defaults to false.

name: UseSpawnLocationType
description: If the type of the falling block should be the one at the spawn location. Defaults to false.

name: FoxType
description: Determines the type of the fox. Can be RED or SNOW. Defaults to RED.

name: Screaming
description: Sets if this is a screaming goat. A screaming goat makes screaming sounds and rams more often. Defaults to false.

name: ImmuneToZombification
description: Whether or not the hoglin is immune to being zombified. Defaults to false.

name: Huntable
description: Whether the hoglin is able to be hunted by piglins. Defaults to true.

name: HorseArmor
description: Used for horses to set the type of armor they have on. Can be iron, gold, or diamond [armor_type] must be in lower case

name: CarryingChest
description: Used for donkeys to set whether they are carrying a chest or not. Defaults to false.

name: HorseColor
description: Sets color of the horse. Colors must be uppercase,can be any of the Spigot Horse colors.

name: HorseStyle
description: Sets the style of the horse. Styles can be any of the Spigot Horse Style

name: HorseType
description: Defines the type of horse Can be any of the Spigot Horse variants Defaults to HORSE Removed in MC 1.11+, useType instead.

name: Height
description: The Height of the Interaction entity. Defaults to 1.

name: Width
description: The Width of the Interaction entity. Defaults to the value of the Height option.
default: the value of the Height option

name: Responsive
description: If the Interaction entity is responsive. Defaults to true.

name: PlayerCreated
description: Acts as if the player built the mob. Defaults to false.

name: Item
description: The material of the item entity. Defaults to STONE.

name: Amount
description: The amount of items in the itemstack. Defaults to 1.

name: CanPickup
description: If the itemstack can be picked up. Defaults to true.

name: Color
description: Sets color of the llama. Colors must be uppercase,can be any of the Spigot Llama colors.

name: ChestContents
description: The droptable that will be put inside the chest.

name: MainGene
description: Sets the main gene that the panda can pass on to its offspring. Can be NORMAL, AGGRESSIVE, LAZY, WORRIED, PLAYFUL, WEAK, BROWN. Defaults to NORMAL.

name: HiddenGene
description: Sets the hidden gene that the panda can pass on to its offspring. Can be NORMAL, AGGRESSIVE, LAZY, WORRIED, PLAYFUL, WEAK, BROWN. Defaults to NORMAL.

name: FlyingSpeed
description: The flying speed of the parrot. Defaults to -1 (The option is not applied)

name: AbleToHunt
description: Whether or not the piglin is able to hunt. Defaults to true.

name: IsKillerBunny
description: Alias: Angry. Sets the rabbit as the Killer Bunny. Defaults to false.

name: RabbitType
description: Sets the type of rabbit. Types can be BLACK, BLACK_AND_WHITE, BROWN, GOLD, SALT_AND_PEPPER, THE_KILLER_BUNNY or WHITE

name: Sheared
description: Whether the Sheep is already sheared. Defaults to false.

name: PreventBlockInfection
description: Prevent silverfish from infecting blocks. Defaults to false.

name: Derp
description: Whether the Snow Golem has its pumpkin already sheared. Defaults to false.

name: PreventSnowFormation
description: Prevent the Snow Golem from creating snow. Defaults to false.

name: ExplosionYield
description: Determines the strength of the explosion. Defaults to -1 (The normal TNT Explosion Yield is used).
default: -1 (The normal TNT Explosion Yield is used

name: Incendiary
description: Whether the explosion is capable of starting fires. Defaults to false.

name: Pattern
description: Sets the Shape/Pattern of the fish.

name: BodyColor
description: Sets the Primary Color of the fish.

name: HasTrades
description: Whether the villager can be traded with. Defaults to false.

name: Profession
description: Specifies the Profession of the villager. Villagers without this option will roll a random profession on their initial spawn.

name: Level
description: Villager profession level, levels 1 - 5. Level 1 villagers might switch professions. If you want a villager to hold its profession, give them a level of 2 or higher. Required if setting villager professions.
